issues.on_page: Irrigation operations and maintenance / General overhead (irrigation district)
issues.issue: The disbursement category rules list 'water and drainage districts' under natural resources/conservation. That category may fit an irrigation district better than utilities. This applies to all 21 non-interest expense lines.
A cost share paid by another district (Northport) could be intergovernmental/state aid (county/other local governments) instead of charges for services. This is a judgment call.
